fact: Egypt's telecommunications minister launched on 26 October 2004 a 400 km fibre-optic cable connecting Egypt and Sudan, built by the Egyptian Telecommunications Company for US$4 million, to carry communications and high-speed internet between the two countries.

Telecom Egypt and Sudatel signed a cooperation agreement in April 2021 to make better use of the terrestrial optical fibre that connects Egypt and Sudan for international traffic, and planned to link Sudatel's Port Sudan landing station to Telecom Egypt's Red Sea landing stations; the document gives no signing day.
